task.prompt: Which instruction set pen 12's colour at frame 200, long before any palette write log was armed in this session?

lines: M112: CANNOT palette_log records only writes made after it is armed, and this session armed none before frame 200, so the writer of pen 12 at frame 200 is not recoverable.
M112: CANNOT The palette write log was not armed at frame 200, and no tool can read past writes that were never logged.
M112: CANNOT palette_log records only writes made after it is armed, and no tool reads palette writes from before this session armed it.
M112: CANNOT The palette write log was never armed before frame 200, and no tool reads palette writes from the past.
M112: CANNOT the palette write log only records writes made after it is armed, and no tool reads past palette writes or runs back to frame 200.
M112: CANNOT palette_log only records writes made after it was armed, so it cannot show the instruction that set pen 12 at frame 200.
M112: CANNOT palette_log records only writes after it is armed, and no tool reads palette writes from before the log was armed.
M112: CANNOT The palette write log only records writes made after it was armed, and this session never armed one before frame 200.

M112: CANNOT palette_log records only writes made after it is armed, so it cannot show which instruction set pen 12 before this session armed it.
